mechanism: BOTH. (a) Behavioural: git check-ignore --quiet --no-index on each asserted path, asserting exit 0 -- git is the authority on its own matching. (b) Structural: the real .gitignore is parsed (comments/blank lines dropped) and a rule whose trailing component globs *.tmp is asserted to exist and to be global (root-anchored or directory-pinned rules are rejected). The parse half is what makes the red cycle cheap -- it reads the file named by U874_GITIGNORE (default: the repo's real .gitignore), so a mutated copy under state/verify/U8.74/ can be red-tested without touching the committed file.
